{
  "hypothesis": "Predicted that line patterns with salient Gestalt information would elicit holistic processing comparable to that of human faces, as indexed by a congruency effect and a Congruency x Alignment interaction in a composite task.",
  "design": "within-subject; factors were alignment (aligned vs. misaligned), congruency (congruent vs. incongruent), and task (composite faces vs. composite line patterns)",
  "manipulation_or_predictor": "Stimulus type (composite faces vs. composite line patterns) combined with alignment and congruency manipulations in a complete composite task design",
  "outcome_measure": "Response sensitivity (d') calculated from same/different judgments on the top parts of the stimuli",
  "population_and_setting": "22 participants tested in a laboratory setting",
  "sample_size_total": 22,
  "recruitment_and_incentive": "Allowed 22 people to register in case some might not show up, and stopped data collection after testing all those who did show up",
  "analysis_plan": "A 2 (alignment) x 2 (congruency) x 2 (task) repeated-measures analysis of variance (ANOVA), followed by separate ANOVAs and t-tests for each task",
  "preregistered_or_confirmatory": "not stated",
  "other_methods_notes": "Participants completed two composite tasks (one with faces, one with line patterns) where they made same/different judgments on the top parts while ignoring the bottom parts."
}
